decisions.conflict: Material and Design Agent recommends PCR PC/ABS blend for recyclability, while In-Service Agent rejects this due to its lower impact resistance compared to high-impact virgin polycarbonate.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: material durability vs end-of-life recyclability
decisions.chief_resolution: Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) Polycarbonate/ABS blend with a monomaterial structure, utilizing optimized internal ribbing and wall thickness to meet drop-test requirements without glass-fiber reinforcement.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability of high-quality PCR PC/ABS suppliers that can guarantee consistent mechanical properties and impact resistance.

options_evaluated: Standardized metric machine screws with threaded brass inserts
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends integrated snap-fits to minimize assembly energy, while Circularity Agent rejects this because snap-fits are prone to breaking during disassembly, preventing repair and material recovery.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing simplicity vs repairability and non-destructive disassembly
decisions.chief_resolution: Standardized metric machine screws with threaded brass inserts to facilitate repeated, non-destructive disassembly for repair and end-of-life material separation.
decisions.design_action: Confirm the availability of standardized metric machine screws and brass inserts in the global supply chain to ensure ease of disassembly.

options_evaluated: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with rare-earth magnets
Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with ferrite or recycled magnets
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends a brushed DC motor to avoid the high manufacturing footprint of rare-earth magnets, while In-Service Agent rejects this due to lower efficiency and shorter operating life compared to a brushless motor.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing impact of raw materials vs in-use energy efficiency and durability
decisions.chief_resolution: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with ferrite magnets or recycled rare-earth magnets to deliver high efficiency and durability while avoiding the environmental impacts of virgin rare-earth mining.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the feasibility of sourcing ferrite magnets or recycled rare-earth magnets that meet the torque requirements of the screwdriver.

options_evaluated: Active cooling via integrated molded plastic fan
Passive cooling via recycled aluminum heatsinks
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends an integrated molded plastic fan for manufacturing simplicity, while Circularity Agent rejects this because active cooling introduces dust and moisture, reducing tool reliability, and prefers a passive aluminum heatsink.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: active cooling performance vs end-of-life material separation and reliability
decisions.chief_resolution: Passive cooling via recycled aluminum heatsinks to protect internal electronics from dust ingress and ensure clean, non-destructive separation of aluminum at end-of-life.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the spatial requirements and weight impact of passive aluminum heatsinks within the housing design.

options_evaluated: Modular cartridge system with plug-and-play modules
Semi-modular design with soldered wire connections
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends a highly integrated monolithic internal chassis to reduce assembly complexity, while In-Service Agent rejects this because it prevents component-level repair and replacement.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing consolidation vs product repairability and modularity
decisions.chief_resolution: Modular cartridge system with plug-and-play modules to enable easy diagnosis, repair, and component harvesting, thereby extending the tool's useful lifespan.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the standard connector interfaces and wiring harness configurations that can fit within the handle volume.

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends an integrated non-removable battery to minimize production waste and material use, while Circularity Agent rejects this because it leads to premature disposal of the entire tool when the battery degrades.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing material reduction vs battery replaceability and end-of-life safety
decisions.chief_resolution: Removable and standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack to prevent premature tool disposal upon battery degradation and ensure safe, separate battery recycling.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the compatibility of the tool with standard slide-on battery pack form factors used by major battery manufacturers to ensure interchangeability.
